caption:
Koko walks a whole pack of dogs every day, and lately every tug on the lead makes her right arm and shoulder ache.

Holding the lead in one hand means those muscles do all the work. Keeping the lead short and close to your body can mean less pulling on the arm.

Hybi's walking tips: hold the lead short and close, swap hands regularly, and stretch your wrists and arms afterwards. Remedial massage may help tight forearms and shoulders feel easier.

Tingling, weakness or trouble gripping is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio
